Maya S: quick sync — we need to lock the compatibility criteria for the smart-routing fallback PRD. bank-client asked for region affinity + guaranteed compatible variant fallbacks.
Ajay R: copying the ask here. do we treat 'compatible' as tokenizer-compatible only or also quantization/ops-compatible?
Maya S: both. customer can't accept tokenization drift. also they want deterministic degradation (clear SLA when we switch variants).
Devon C: edge case — KV cache from a different model family can corrupt context if we fall back to a variant with different vocab/embedding sizes. we must invalidate cache on cross-family fallback.
Lucas W: proposal: tier map => premium routes: same-region + same-arch fallback only; standard: same-region or cross-region same-arch; best-effort: any compatible tokenizer (with degrade warnings).
Kiran P: +1 on invalidating KV cache cross-family. also need a fast compatibility check at routing time (cheap signature): model.arch, tokenizer.hash, embed-dim, supported-ops.
Nina (PM): acceptance criteria draft (short):
```
AC-1: Fallback must only select variants that match tokenizer.hash.
AC-2: If fallback changes model.arch or embed-dim, system must invalidate KV cache and mark request TTD (trace).
AC-3: For premium tier, fallback must stay within same-region and same-arch; otherwise reject and surface 503 to caller.
AC-4: Fallback selection latency (routing decision) <= 20ms p95.
AC-5: Regression test: prompt-set X must have <2% semantic drift after fallback compared to primary.
```
Ajay R: routing policy proto snippet I sketched: `tier_policy = { premium: [region_affinity:true, arch_strict:true], standard: [region_affinity:true, arch_strict:false], best_effort: [region_affinity:false, tokenizer_strict:true] }`
Devon C: can we add a soft-fallback mode for degraded outputs: app sees `x-fallback-reason` header and can opt into safety filtering? customer asked for that.
Maya S: yes — add header + console event + alerting for >1% fallback rate per route.
OpsBot: rollout-note: canary routing change applied to us-west-2 (10%) at 2026-03-18T09:12Z.
Lucas W: launch checklist items to agree: PRD, spec doc, compatibility matrix, e2e test harness (simulated load + prompt set), canary plan + rollback.
Nina (PM): prioritization: bank-client requires GA before their audit window (2026-05-01). realistically we need spec locked by 2026-04-01, dev + e2e by 2026-04-20, canary by 2026-04-27.
Kiran P: risks: kernel compatibility for quantized variants may cause slight perf regressions — need perf guardrails in Optimize to suggest alternate quantization.
Maya S: scope negotiation: if time boxed, drop best-effort cross-family fallbacks for v1. keep premium + standard only.
Ajay R: assigned actions: Ajay -> write routing proto + compatibility check lib (due 2026-03-30). Devon -> KV invalidation flow + tests (due 2026-03-30). Lucas -> canary plan + observability (due 2026-04-05). Nina -> finalize customer acceptance criteria + communicate scope (due 2026-03-25).
Devon C: noted. one more edge case: model name aliasing (v1 vs v1-quant) — compatibility table must map aliases to canonical tokenizer hash.
Maya S: good catch. add to spec.
Nina (PM): I'll open the PRD draft after this thread and tag owners. thanks everyone — short sync done. :thumbsup:
